name: fix66-shopfront
note: L1 Main Row shop fronts and courier depot frontage at the game camera, zoom 0.5 / 1.0 / 1.5 along the pavement. Look for: a continuous walkable pavement strip between the facades/planters and the kerb, no 0.5 m slits behind planters or benches, planters flush to the facade, collision matching the visuals.
